ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in the Sahel changed by +0.212 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.146 to +0.277), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.523 mm/day.

ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in the Sahel changed by +0.230 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.142 to +0.321), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.568 °C.

cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in the Sahel changed by +0.013 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval 0.000 to +0.026), which is statistically significant (p = 0.04). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.033 mm/day.

ranking.name: Water running off the surface
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water running off the surface in the Sahel shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.20): the estimate is +0.0054 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.0031 to +0.0136). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in the Sahel shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.24): the estimate is +0.10 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval −0.06 to +0.27). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
